en: A sepia-toned historic postcard showing a mountain village beneath dramatic rocky peaks. The image includes a prominent church with a steeple and several buildings, many of which appear to be heavily damaged or in ruins. The towering mountains in the background are labeled with their names and elevations. There is Italian text at the top referring to an event during World War I.
